text:
Alex (PM): quick intake — customer asks for configurable "quality gates" per-customer and per-route. problem: teams want to set a minimum quality threshold and automatic fallback to a cheaper model if threshold fails. need: PRD-level requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout constraints, and edge cases. can owners weigh in?
Maria (Eng): +1. initial thoughts: this touches routing, runtime, and the console. we may need a new API field (route.quality_threshold) and runtime check on top-k outputs. perf impact if we evaluate more than top-1.
Sam (ML): for clarity — what is the quality signal? is it log-likelihood, label-match, or a downstream eval? different signals have very different compute profiles.
Alex (PM): goal: let customers provide a small eval set and a metric (e.g., label-match rate or embed-sim threshold) used by our rollout gate. non-goal: not building a full evaluation platform in the first phase.
Priya (Legal): heads up — for Private/VPC customers we must ensure the eval sets do not leave their network. KMS/HSM mention for any uploaded data.
Jess (SRE): rollout constraints: we should only enable auto-fallback for Dedicated/Hosted customers after canary. propose staged rollouts: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks. also need circuit-breaker for repeated failures.
Alex (PM): acceptance criteria draft (please critique):
```
- API: accept route.quality_threshold config and metric_type (label_match|embed_sim|logprob).
- Console: UI to upload a small eval set and show per-model metric.
- Runtime: evaluate threshold on responses and route to fallback model if below threshold.
- Metrics: surface success rate, fallback rate, avg latency, cost delta.
- Security: eval data for Private must stay in-customer env; confirm KMS integration.
- Rollout: staged % rollout with automatic rollback on quality regression > 2% absolute or SLO breach.
```
Maria (Eng): technical questions/edge cases:
- how to compute label_match for open-domain responses? need matching function (exact vs fuzzy).
- embed_sim requires computing embedding of reference and candidate — that adds embedding calls. caching possible but complexity grows.
- sequence-length outliers may change metric distribution. need guardrails.
Sam (ML): propose sensible defaults: label_match with fuzzy token-match (token-set overlap > X), embed_sim default threshold 0.8. require customers to provide >= 50 eval examples per route for signal reliability. mention A/B harness to validate threshold before enabling auto-fallback.
Jess (SRE): monitoring and rollback triggers (signals):
- quality_rate drop > 2% absolute over 30m -> alert and pause rollout.
- fallback_rate > 20% for 10m -> investigate model degradation or misconfigured threshold.
- latency p95 increase > 30% -> pause.
- cost-per-1000-tokens increase > 15% -> flag for finance review.
Priya (Legal): also require audit log entries for threshold changes and who uploaded eval sets. retention policy for eval data configurable per-customer.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window requested: wed 02:00-04:00 UTC for initial canary.
Alex (PM): open questions for next steps:
- owners: Maria (eng) for API/runtime, Sam (ml) for metric defs, Jess (sre) for rollout/monitoring, Priya (legal) for data controls.
- deliverables: PRD draft + shortlist of 3 fallback model strategies (cheapest-compatible, same-arch-quantized, reduced-context variant).
- success metrics (proposal):
  - quality regression <= 1% on evaluation sets after rollout
  - fallback rate < 10% at steady state
  - p95 latency within existing SLO for the route
  - unit cost delta < 15% vs baseline for routes using fallback

Maria (Eng): I can mock API shape and runtime check in a spike next week. will call out perf numbers.
Sam (ML): I'll draft evaluation definitions and a small eval harness we can run in CI to validate thresholds.
Jess (SRE): I'll add metrics + alert playbook and a runbook for rollback.
Priya (Legal): I'll add language for Private deployments and audit requirements.
Alex (PM): thanks all. let's sync Tue 10am to review PRD draft. :eyes:
Maria (Eng): :thumbsup:
Sam (ML): :thumbsup:
Jess (SRE): noted, will prep runbook snippets.
Priya (Legal): acknowledged.
Alex (PM): assigning owners in the PRD doc after meeting. thanks everyone. :tada:
